method: Actual official DevKit preview entry, native Chromium CDP contacts, ordinary DevKit keys; copied p0.hud observations only.

checks.name: expanded left target edge outside visible key
expanded right target edge outside visible key
expanded jump target edge outside visible key
left/right sliding, crossing origins and off-button releases preserve the other thumb
left and right duplicate-contact reference counts
blank third-contact release preserves both controls
Space after failure restarts immediately, held retry cannot jump, release/new press jumps
BREW AGAIN hold across countdown does not carry jump; fresh contact jumps
pause clears held touch; resume has no held steering or jump
shell focus-reset clears contacts and pauses; resume is neutral

limitations: The current official SDK strips pointer IDs and does not forward pointercancel or a blur event. Contact matching uses the official per-contact x/y and dx/dy.
An OS cancellation without a shell input reset, resize or interruption is not immediately observable through this SDK. This test does not claim an invented cancellation signal.
